$description: Project configuration for the token sync pipeline.

figma.$description: Figma file and Variable Collection configuration.

collections.$description: One list per role — several physical Figma collections can back the same role (Figma allows only one mode-axis per collection). Use the plugin's Map Collections screen instead of hand-editing this.

figma.$note: Themes collection modes: one per named theme (Original, Zero…). Semantic collection modes: Light, Dark (+ any user-added modes like Contrast). Switch theme and color scheme independently in Figma. `sizes` is an optional second axis on Primitives (e.g. mobile/desktop breakpoints) — see docs/design/size-axis.md.

css.$description: Single CSS file. Use [data-theme] and [data-color-scheme] attributes for switching.

js.$description: ES module per color scheme, resolved through the first theme.
